purpose: Current Wiki verification of every retained surface lodestone and City of Um; one bounded Anachronia base-region correction.

currentWikiApi.method: query revisions: latest ids, timestamp, main-slot wikitext; redirects enabled; no oldid in request

discovery.query: site:runescape.wiki Anachronia lodestone Ashdale Prifddinas lodestone coordinates
discovery.role: Discovery only; all recorded coordinates and membership come from current Wiki API revisions.

limits: Schema build 950 is inferred compatibility, not verified live client build.
Region verification uses current Wiki scenery anchors; it does not certify exact teleport tile, authored suffix, collision component or personal activation.
No walking edge, underground entrance, account flag, quest completion or teleport permission is inferred from coordinates.
Lunar Isle and Fort Forinthry cache destinations differ from the scenery anchor by (4,-2) and (0,-2); their base regions agree.
Al Kharid ordinary active/inactive variants are F2P; the Ode of the Devourer scenery-only variant is members.
